answer.reason: The BLS QCEW 2024 Q4 Arkansas statewide data report the private-sector covered employment level for NAICS 23 Construction as 66,931 jobs, matching option B rather than 52,500.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Arkansas, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 52,500 covered jobs
B. 66,931 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Arkansas statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/05000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
